No, express shipping isn't available at 1,200 miles. That puts you in Zone 3 (over 1,000 miles from our nearest greenhouse), and Express isn't offered there. Standard shipping to Zone 3 takes 5-8 business days and costs $7.95, or is free on orders of $75 or more (after discounts, before tax).

Live plants ship Monday to Wednesday only, so an order placed after 12 noon on Wednesday will ship the following Monday. Also, XL plants (usually over 4 ft) add a $20 handling fee.
